newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian jet fighter crashes, pilot parachutes.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian jet fighter crashes, pilot parachutes.

text.p: A Norwegian Air Force F-16 jet fighter crashed into the sea off mid-Norway on Thursday after apparently flying into an electricity line, an Air Force spokesman said.
The pilot, Captain Per Maarten Storengen, parachuted to safety and landed on an island, where he was later picked up by a helicopter, the spokesman told Reuters.
Storengen was flying in formation with five other F-16s simulating attack on sea targets when the accident occured north of the west coast city of Bergen.

"The pilot was heading the formation and he probably hit an electricity line at an altitude of 1,000 feet," the spokesman said. "He reported engine problems and said he was going to parachute. He is unharmed."
The national news agency NTB said it was the 16th F-16 to crash in Norway since the Air Force started using the plane in 1980. Six pilots have died.
